title: put-agent-builder-agents-id-access-control
description: Update an agent's access control list

id.description: The unique identifier of the agent whose access control to update.
Stable identifier of the user to grant access to (Kibana user profile uid). Preferred over `name`.

name.description: Case-sensitive Kibana username of the user to grant access to. Still supported, but `id` is preferred for new grants because a username cannot distinguish same-named users across authentication realms.

role.description: Role granted to the principal. Roles are hierarchical: `user` allows viewing, listing, reading, and running the agent; `editor` adds updating the agent configuration; `manager` adds deleting the agent and managing its access control.

entries.description: Access-control entries to apply to the agent. Each entry has a `type` (for example `user`), a `role`, and either an `id` (the principal user profile uid, preferred) or a deprecated `name` (username).
